correctness.rationale: For odd q, n>=3 and 2<=m<=n-1, s=n-m, Lee–Park Proposition 3.6 directly identifies E1 matrices as shifted coefficients f,xf,...,x^(m-1)f with deg f<=s. No truncation because deg(x^(m-1)f)<=n-1. Thus U_f=f Fq[x]_<m. If f=da,g=db coprime a,b, common elements fu=gv imply u=bh,v=ah; dim intersection=max(0,m-(max(deg f,deg g)-deg d)). Distinct classes iff f,g not proportional. Ordered gcd decomposition into monic pair plus monic d yields A_t-A_(t-1)=(q+1)q^(2t-1) and N_t=(q+1)q^(2t-1)*(q^(s-t+1)-1)/(q-1), summing to L(L-1). Independent q=3,m=2,n=4 full 13-projective-word intersection enumeration gets t1=48,t2=108, distances 2,4. This is a proof for all odd prime powers, finite checks supplementary.
